quantity: retained slide bits from a fresh probe scored on HELD-OUT SLIDES
status: REPLACED by D-35 before any scored run
reason: declared first: "freeze the encoder, train a new discriminator from scratch, score on slides it never saw"
note: REPLACED, NOT DELETED. Structurally impossible, and the replacement for the already-defective D-15 metric repeats D-15's error. The probe is an N-way SLIDE classifier; holding out slide IDs asks it to name classes it never saw one example of, so it can never be right. Measured on the smoke folds: fresh_acc exactly 0.000000 on 4 of 4 (chance on 751 slides is 0.13%, so exact zero is structural), fresh_bits -28.5 against a ceiling of log2(751) = 9.55, a value the quantity cannot take. The co-trained column carried the same defect more gently (-0.4 to -0.7) because slide_split makes train and val slides disjoint

quantity: retained slide bits from a fresh probe trained and scored on DISJOINT CELLS OF THE SAME SLIDES, full slide vocabulary
reason: "fresh" means freshly initialised and never adversarially trained, which is the actual protection against the encoder hiding information from one particular discriminator rather than removing it. Held-out CELLS still test generalisation: if the probe recovers slide identity from cells it never saw, the signature is genuinely in z_cell
note: retained_bits = log2(N_slides) - CE_bits, 0 at chance, scale-free across lambda (D-15). Reported absolutely and as a fraction of the lambda=0 value. Needs a 4th cell draw (sprobe) taken from the TRAIN slides and held out of the training draw

quantity: mean LOCO macro-F1 of the shipped lambda minus the same quantity for a MAJORITY-CLASS predictor
reason: the encoder must have learned something transferable. A cross-cohort classifier that cannot beat 'always predict the commonest training cluster' has not earned the stage
note: both baselines are computed inside the same run on the same folds and the same waiver, so the comparison needs no external number and no guessed threshold. A random-uniform baseline is reported alongside

quantity: mean LOCO macro-F1 of the shipped lambda minus the same quantity for a RANDOM-UNIFORM predictor
reason: a floor below the majority test, kept because macro-F1 can favour a random predictor over a majority one when classes are very unbalanced - so passing only the majority test is not sufficient on its own
note: reported per fold as well as on the mean

reason: pick the lambda maximising mean LOCO macro-F1 over the 5 folds. Ties break to the SMALLER lambda - a weaker adversary is the simpler model and the plan's stated fallback direction
note: FALLBACK declared in the plan and kept: if no lambda beats lambda=0, ship lambda=0 and say so plainly. A working model beats a broken idea. This is a selection rule, not a threshold - it cannot fail, it can only choose

quantity: retained slide bits across the lambda grid
reason: a monotone fall is what a working adversary looks like. If bits do not fall as lambda rises, the gradient reversal layer is not doing anything and the sweep is measuring noise
note: NOT a pass/fail. D-15 exists precisely because an unreachable adversary threshold could fail an adversary that was working. Reported absolutely and as a fraction of the lambda=0 value

quantity: cohort-head accuracy on the training cohorts' held-out slides
decides: INVERTED GUARD - a WARNING if it FAILS low
reason: read backwards from every other check in this project. Cohort is confounded with tissue on this roster (colorectal
column13: so an embedding that cannot tell the cohorts apart cannot tell colon from lung either - and colon and lung tumour cells genuinely differ. Falling to chance is destruction of biology being reported as success
column14: chance is 1/n_cohort where n_cohort is the 4 training cohorts left in each LOCO fold, so 0.25 and the guard sits at 0.375. Scored on the training cohorts because the held-out cohort has no class in that head. The cohort head carries only COHORT_FRAC = 0.1 of lambda for the same reason

quantity: co-trained retained bits minus fresh-probe retained bits
reason: a large gap means the adversary is HIDING slide information from the discriminator it trained against rather than REMOVING it - the encoder found a direction that one discriminator was not looking in. Invisible with either number alone, which is why both are reported
note: no threshold declared: the size of an acceptable gap is not knowable in advance on this roster. Reported side by side per lambda so the trend is auditable
